# Mike's Handyman Service

## Business Overview

Mike's Handyman Service is a veteran-owned, insured, and background-checked handyman service based in Austin, Texas. Owner Mike has completed 660+ jobs and responds to new requests in about 41 minutes on average. The business holds a 4.9-star rating across 110 reviews on Thumbtack and a 5.0-star rating across 384 reviews on TaskRabbit, and has earned Thumbtack Top Pro status for 2024 and 2025.

Book online at: https://sample-handyman.com/#booking  
Phone: (512) 244-8550  
Hours: Monday–Sunday, 8 AM – 8 PM

## Services

### Ceiling Fan & Electrical

Mike's Handyman Service installs, replaces, and repairs ceiling fans — including ceiling fans with lights and outdoor ceiling fans. Mike also handles light fixture installation and replacement (including recessed lighting, chandeliers, and outdoor fixtures), dimmer switch installation, light switch replacement, outlet repair, GFCI outlet installation, and general electrical repairs for homeowners in Austin TX, Round Rock TX, and surrounding Travis County. Customers searching for "ceiling fan installation near me," "install ceiling fan near me," "electrician near me," or "outlet not working" in the Austin and Round Rock area can book directly on the website.

### TV Mounting & Shelving

TV mounting is one of Mike's Handyman Service's most popular services. Mike mounts flat-screen TVs of any size — including 65-inch, 70-inch, and 85-inch TVs — on drywall, brick, and above fireplaces. Services include full-motion and fixed bracket installation, in-wall cable concealment, and cable management. He also installs floating shelves, gallery walls, heavy mirrors, and picture hanging. Customers searching "TV mounting near me," "TV wall mount installation near me," "mount TV above fireplace near me," "hide TV cables near me," or "floating shelves near me" in Austin TX or Round Rock TX can book online.

### Plumbing Repairs

Mike's Handyman Service handles light plumbing repairs that don't require a plumbing license: leaky faucet repair, dripping faucet repair, faucet replacement (bathroom and kitchen), running toilet repair, toilet installation, garbage disposal installation and replacement, showerhead replacement, and slow drain repair. Customers searching "plumber near me," "faucet repair near me," "leaky faucet repair near me," "garbage disposal installation near me," or "toilet repair near me" in Austin TX or Round Rock TX can request service online.

### Furniture Assembly

Mike's Handyman Service assembles flat-pack and ready-to-assemble furniture from any retailer — IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon, West Elm, Pottery Barn, and others. Types include bed frames, dressers, desks, bookshelves, TV stands, wardrobes, and home office furniture. Customers searching "IKEA assembly near me," "furniture assembly near me," "IKEA furniture assembly canton ga," "Wayfair assembly near me," or "someone to assemble furniture near me" in the Austin and Round Rock area can book online.

### Home Repairs & Maintenance

General home repairs including drywall patching and repair (holes, cracks, water damage), door repair (sticking doors, misaligned doors, door hinge replacement), baseboard installation, trim work, weatherstripping replacement, caulking (bathtubs, windows, doors), and interior maintenance tasks. Customers searching "drywall repair near me," "hole in wall repair near me," "door repair near me," "baseboard installation near me," or "home repair near me" in Austin TX or Round Rock TX can request service on the website.
